name: accelerate-analyzer
description: Combat robot engineering skills for Claude Code: weapon-impact simulation on your robot's CAD, and STEP file analysis.

plugins.name: combat-robot-analyzer
plugins.description: Find out what an opponent's spinning weapon does to your robot: analyse a STEP, set materials and the weapon (presets or fully custom), mesh, solve with OpenRadioss and read the damage, all locally under nix-shell.

plugins.name: cad-step
plugins.description: Analyze STEP/STP CAD files: assembly trees, part placements and coordinate frames, hole and bolt-circle tables, mass properties, clash detection, fastener bills of materials, SVG technical drawings, entity queries and revision diffs.
